title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire and partners in Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray works towards the goal that people in crisis can meet their basic needs. This objective focuses on ensuring people affected can hold us accountable to our commitments. Activities focus on safe and appropriate mechanisms that support the two-way flow of information, assistance is safe, inclusive and informed by ongoing monitoring of protection risks. The principal focus of this objective is: - Establish new systems & structures through which groups, communities or people can lead the response through an active and influential role in shaping decisions that affect their lives - Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys
